verdict.rationale: Docs mention accepting USDC or USDT with no gas fees (docs-21) and support EVM/Solana wallets (gh-1), and Base network is referenced for agentic wallets, but there is no comprehensive documented table of supported stablecoins across multiple named chains (e.g., Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum) — most references are Base/EVM-generic. Missing for 10: an explicit multi-chain stablecoin support matrix, coverage beyond USDC/USDT, and named additional networks beyond Base/EVM/Solana.
